note: One row per private release, appended by `agentic-kit release prepare --write` (.agentic/config.yaml release.version_anchors): the app version (pyproject, agp_cockpit.version APP_VERSION), the release build id `release-<app>` (rebuilds between releases carry `-r<N>` in BRIDGE_BUILD_ID), the Kit version it was prepared with, date and tag. The Chrome extension version lives in chrome_extension/manifest.json only. Private release policy: docs/planning/RELEASE_POLICY.md.

releases.how: manual (owner's decision 2026-10-02): Kit 1.0.13 has no private release route (KIT-GF-029, KIT-GF-032); version files and changelog in this branch, annotated tag set by the owner on main after the merge.
